subtitle: Lesson 16 · SOSL & Search

eyebrow: A search, not a table query
code:
FIND {Acme}
IN ALL FIELDS
RETURNING Account, Contact, Lead

-- no FROM, no WHERE
caption: Salesforce Object Search Language.

steps.label: ALL FIELDS
steps.sub: the default; every searchable text field

code:
FIND {Acme*} IN NAME FIELDS
RETURNING Account, Contact
LIMIT 50

*  any number of characters
?  exactly one character
caption: Text only. Up to 2,000 records in total.
